name: Radar 7: Create Spreadsheet
description: Competitor radar (project 12): run once to create the Google Sheet the radar runs on.

parameters.jsCode:
const c = $('Create Spreadsheet').first().json;
return [{ json: { spreadsheetId: c.spreadsheetId, url: c.spreadsheetUrl, next: 'Put the ID in workflows/config.json (SHEET_ID), rebuild and deploy, then run Radar 6: Reset Demo.' } }];

parameters.content:
## Radar 7: Create Spreadsheet
Run once when setting up for a new client. Creates the Google Sheet the radar runs on (Settings, Watchlist, Our Products, Matches, Prices, Changes, Runs, Outbox) with bold, frozen header rows. The team can edit the watchlist, products and settings in the sheet; the workflows write plain text so nothing is treated as a formula.
